item_short_desc: Rothco’s Medical Rescue Response Bag is designed for versatility and convenience, offering ample storage and organization for first responders on the go. Constructed from rugged polyester material, this emergency bag features a 3-section central compartment along with 2 zipper side pockets, 2 open top front pockets, and a zipper pocket inside the front flap with tool loops. The front flap is secured with a quick-release buckle and hook-and-loop closure for added protection of your medical supplies.
description: Rothco’s Medical Rescue Response Bag is designed for versatility and convenience, offering ample storage and organization for first responders on the go. Constructed from rugged polyester material, this emergency bag features a 3-section central compartment along with 2 zipper side pockets, 2 open top front pockets, and a zipper pocket inside the front flap with tool loops. The front flap is secured with a quick-release buckle and hook-and-loop closure for added protection of your supplies. For easy transport, the bag comes with a detachable and adjustable shoulder strap and a top carry handle. Additionally, the response bag includes a reflective Star of Life emblem for enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. This spacious medic bag measures 15 inch x 9 inch x 7 inch, providing ample room for all your essentials.
